        5 out of 5 stars
        Best phone in the segment
        Reviewed in India on 20 May 2022
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Got it for 36k with all offers(no exchange)

        at this price you get all of the ultra high end specs you will ever need. Games load near instantly, animations are smooth, memory management is excellent,overall camera setup is quite excellent compared to competitors who are using 2mp macro and depth sensors.

        Other than that, the display is crisp and so fluid, you will be completely satisfied with it.

        Battery life is also excellent but be aware, first charge cycle you wont get good battery life, I got sot of around 6 hrs after first charge, after that I got SOT of more than 7 hours with 60-80 mins of medium gaming and 120hz refresh rate locked and always on display turned on.

        And also the charger is super fast, expect 0-100 in about 19 minutes which is crazy for the price!!

        Even I was hesitant at first due to some bad reviews regarding heating, I only faced heating issue during first day, after that it has stopped heating up. Maybe it was due to first time setup of the phone. Phone runs cool and smooth now and I have no complaints. Go for it guys, if you can get it under 40k.

        Pros:

        Top of the line specs

        Build quality is amazing, feels like a flagship with the aluminum frame and glass back.

        Excellent battery life

        Fluid 10 bit amoled display

        Great rear camera setup(gimbal camera setup with 13 mp wide and 13mp 2x telephoto lens!)

        Android 12 out of the box and funtouch os is quite fun!

        Cons

        1. front cam can only record 1080p 30 which can be deal breaker for some but idc about front video recording, rear videos are excellent.

      • SHAROBIN
        4 out of 5 stars
        Over-all Best premium phone with all that I want.
        Reviewed in India on 4 October 2022
        Colour: LegendSize: 256GBStyle Name: 12GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Overall its best premium budget phone. I've upgraded from Oneplus 7 and compared to that its definitely an upgrade as I've spent same amount as on iqoo 9 i.e. 35k 3 years back.

        1. Camera - it has good camera setup, gives sharp images, 2x is very good and gives better quality and colour pics. Main camera photos are very sharp and has natural colours so you have apply some filter to make them eye pleasant before posting anywhere. The details are also very good. Ultrawide gives same quality photos as 2x and doesn't require filters for that.

        2. Performance is very good. BGMI can be played at 90 fps but i use smooth with extreme settings with 2x antialiasing. Half hour drops battery by 11%. I've played 3 hours 15 mins continuously and there was no drop in performance. Heating was there but my OP7 also had same level of heating but not that much and can be played with. One thing i noticed is u can't use charger while playing games at 120w and charging is limited to normal speeds like 10w charger does. Once the phone cools down 120w resumes and charges phone in mere minutes. Other than that ther is no lag in performance all things works very fast and fine.

        3. Screen - Screen is very good and gives very good colours. 10 bit diffrence is seen from OP7.

        Refresh rate however feels a gimmick to me as sometimes when scrolling through touch gets missed while screen is in motion and can only be used when a page settles. Although once You get used to 120 fps u can't go back to 60fps as animations feel laggy but touch is snappier at 60fps. So I'd suggest using smart switch option.

        4. Battery- Charging is awesome only takes minutes to charge the phone. As i mostly charge my device fro near about 30%. Sometimes when i get home from office the phone charges during just changing clothes to full.

        About battery backup it gives 6-7 hours of Screen on time on an average. I've attached screenshots of backup that I'm getting. As I've estimated You can play 4.5 hours continuously BGMI at 60fps. So during movies and videos it will last even more. Casually it lasts a day so no worries with some charge left and can be charged within 15 mins which is awesome. Lastly standby time is also very good.

        5. UI- the UI is good. Don't give unnecessary permissions to phone and apps. Never open browser app and use chrome instead and abolish all permissions of browser app and avoid using any in-built apps linked to iqoo. I've removed all bloatware and haven't seen any adds or recommendations.

        6. Sound - sound is good not too loud or smashy.

        Overall iqoo 9 ticks all the requirements like good camera, very good performance, excellent charging, good battery backup, very good display and looks premium. So I'd say its definitely worth your Money and you'll enjoy using it.

        After 2 Months and Android 13 Review -

        1. Everything works fine no problem in performance or anything.

        2. Battery backup remains the same almost negligible difference. I'd suggest using dark mode to increase battery backup to get more 1-2 hrs of screen on time (SOT). I'm getting 9hrs+ SOT with dark mode without gaming and for gaming remains the same.

        3. Few more options are added like extra dim and vowifi in quick notification toggle. More colour pellets can be used in customisation options to improve overall UI aesthetics.

        4. Camera quality remains the same no changes.

        All is good and can definitely be updated to Android 13.

        Thanks 🙏🙏

        Great Phone. Updated review after 5 months usage
        Reviewed in India on 7 March 2022
        Colour: LegendSize: 128GBStyle Name: 8GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Guys, avoid if possible. Phone heats up just while browsing (surface temperature of 38C). While gaming, battery temperature is about 46C and cpu temperature is 65C. Also Antutu score on my device is about 800k !

        Edit:

        After a week of usage, I started liking the phone. Top reasons below.

        - amazingly fast charging with pretty good battery backup - charge for 20 mins once 36 hours on average

        - Gaming experience improved in monster mode.

        - Super fast performance

        - amazing pictures

        Heating issue isn't unmanageable. But needs to be improved through software optimizations. Power saving mode is useless. Won't feel heating in regular usage. There are some bugs in se, which needs fix.

        Edit:

        After using for about 5 months, most software bugs resolved via OTA updates. Heating is negligible. Hard to notice in day to day usage. Updating from 4 star to 5 star. Go for it without second thoughts.

        •

        •

        My Review & Ratings : As per my 8-months experience. (25-11-2022)

        { In Short : It is a "performance centric" smartphone with great "camera" & "build+design." }

        Ya , you can call it an "ALL-ROUND"

        smartphone :)

        1) Design & Build : Design is subjective but , for me Its one of 'The Best' looking smart phone. I just love it from the beginning.Build is Also just awesome , sides metallic and premium glass back , excellent top notch build. Combined Build & design make this smart phone a very premium device. You can feel it for sure. {10/10}

        2) Performance : 888+ is not 100% optimized so far , but with 4 Updates alot optimization had been done by Iqoo. Personally I never faced any problem related to performance , No lag , Its just run like a butter in any task. Just a little heating issues but I say most of the heating issues had been resolved by Updates (60 to 65%)*No heating after 8 Months* So ,{10/10}

        3) Battery : For me better is just Phenomenal. I don't know why people complaining about battery. Its easily gives me (7 to 8H) of SOT in medium use & upto 6 H of battery in heavy gaming+recording. Average SOT - 6:30 to 7:30 , I don't know what people expect from 4350 MAH battery. According to the battery , the SOT is excellent. {10/10}

        4) Charging Speed : Its just ⚡. Full charge in just 19 to 20 min. 0 to 50 in just 5 min. {10/10}

        5) Camera : Back camera is great , can say one of the best best camera in the segment. But front camera is not that much good. I don't know why , it has 16 Mp front camera but picture quality doesn't look that great or best according to specifications. I think it needs optimization in front camera department.*Fromt cam optimized in Android 13 update* Now perform better than before.

        VIDEO RECORDING : Experience is very very satisfying with gimble stabilization , works just great. {9.5/10} Just need to improve front cam.

        6) Display & Sound : No complain , Top notch {10/10} (but doesn't support dolby atmos).

        7) UI Experience : I never faced any major problem with this UI ( Fun touch os ) , You can coustomized your phone in many ways . Previously I'm a Stock UI user as compared to that ya , I can say it doesn't feels that much great but No problem with fun touch os till now. Minor bugs fix & Little optimization needs in UI department. Although I can't find any issue in the UI till now. But as per others openions : They say better UI options are available in the market in this segment.

        From my prospective : I only used two UI so far , For me it is good. {9.5/10}

        8) Coustomer support : Is also very good. All Updates are in time {10/10}

        9) 5G : Eight 5G bands that will be supported in India (600 MHz, 700 MHz, 800 MHz, 900 MHz, 1800 MHz, 2100 MHz, 2300 MHz, and 2500 MHz) All these 8 bands are present in this device. So , Its a complete 5G device. {10/10}

        10) Gaming Experience : There are so many features related to games in it , that increase the overall gaming experience. "Monster Mode" , "Dual - Monster Touch " and many more unique features. Dual X-Axis Linear Motor to provide the good haptics experience , Advanced Liquid Cooling System enhance the gaming experience. {10/10}

        •

        •

        •

        "The only reason you doesn't go with IQOO 9 in 40k segment is : If you like some other 'Brand'."

        If just brand or a name matter for you.

        But I say IQOO is now a well know brand too.😅

        In Short :

        This device just need Optimization in :

        •) Front Camera : Need much improvement & optimization in front camera. (No improvement till now)

        •) Heat Management : (60 to 65% heating problem solved) in 5 months with help of "4" updates. Needs full optimization in heat management.

        •) UI : Also need to optimize the UI(Fun-Touch) OS little bit.

        Except this the device is "TOP NOTCH" in every department.

        After some optimization in the above ' 'department' this device will surely become "The Phenomenal One", "The Best" ,"The Around Beast" , "The True Legend"

        Believe that.

        {When the optimizations I mentioned above will be done by IQOO I'll definitely rate it 5/5)

        "It's damn time...." ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Fully optimized now.😉

        PERFORMANCE + CAMERA + LOOKS/DESIGN & BUILD = IQOO 9 in short ~ "Its A Phenomenal Device Go For It."

Its 120 watt charger helps you to charge your phone within 17 mins according to me as it did in my case may vary person to person for their surrounding environment and the cooling system of this phone is also very good which makes you phone cool down upto 5 degree Celsius in 2-3 mins.         So the Conclusion is at at price of 35k (I got it at Rs.33990 in Amazon BBD) its a superb phone and you should absolutely go for it without thinking much...I am sure it will be a phone worth to its price...a nice work by IQOO

      • Amen Ave
        3 out of 5 stars
        Strong Hardware, Lacklustre Software
        Reviewed in India on 31 March 2022
        Colour: LegendSize: 128GBStyle Name: 8GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Having used the phone for a few days, I wanted to sum up my impressions of the phone so far in the form of pros and cons, so here goes:

        Pros:

        1. Phone is light enough for everyday use.

        2. 120W Fast Charging - Fully charges the phone in 18 minutes from 15%-100% (Tested multiple times).

        3. 120Hz screen refresh rate makes UI interactions feel buttery smooth.

        4. Usable triple cameras - Unlike other companies which give 108MP camera and then 8MP ultra-wide and 2MP ‘macro’ lens; the cameras on the iQOO 9 are all usable. The 48MP primary camera captures excellent ‘almost’ true to life colours (when compared with my Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 3 which has a tendency to oversaturate sometimes). The 13MP ultra-wide while not the best is atleast marginally better than the 8MP ultrawide cameras that Chinese companies have been using for several years now. The 13MP telephoto lens is also more useful than the 2MP or 5MP ‘macro’ cameras that you can find in other companies. While only carrying a 2x zoom, its handy for portrait shots and the occasional zoomed photo.

        5. The Price - After exchanging my old Redmi Note 5 Pro and other discounts, I got the phone for 32k which is quite a good deal considering the features on hand.

        Cons:

        1. Erratic Performance - While playing games, whether they’re graphically demanding or lightweight games, the system is unable to maintain 60fps. This is because of the Ultra Game Booster software which physically limits the framerate, and even while playing CODM, PUBG, Genshin Impact - the framerate is about 40fps or thereabouts. Its only after enabling frame rate booster (or whatever its called), that the framerate increases to 60fps. While playing lightweight games like ‘Idle Arks’ which runs beautifully on my Z Fold 3 at 60fps, the iQOO 9 with its Snapdragon 888+ is unable to hit 60fps and instead gives out 30fps which feels choppy. Even after disabling the Ultra Game booster (or whatever its called), the FPS doesn’t reach 60fps even in simple games like Solitaire.

        2. The above issue might seem like a small one given that only games are affected and other elements of the UI function well. However, what frustrates me is the fact that iQOO can’t even seem to get the optimisations right for the powerful SD888+ leaving the phone unable to reach its true potential. The software feels half baked - with regards to gaming and I wish iQOO did something about it. Other than that, its a good Mid-range device and only the software limits it from reaching the full potential that it could.
